_: Voices designed for the cast (npm run short -- --design <id>), by character. Delete one to design it again.

conehead.brief: A deranged, high, nasal, wet voice belonging to a grinning cone-headed creature. Sing-song and far too cheerful, spit bubbling on every S, sudden manic giggles, voice cracking and wobbling, unsettling pauses in the wrong places. Abrasive and off-putting.

bigeye.brief: A paranoid, intense, too-loud old man who sees everything, gravelly and strained, hissing through yellow teeth, every sentence an accusation, eye twitching in his voice.

redeye.brief: A dry, cracked, sleep-deprived whisper, raspy and flat and eerily calm, as if staring without blinking, with long unnerving pauses and a twitch catching in the throat.

droopy.brief: An extremely slow, sagging, monotone old voice whose pitch droops at the end of every phrase, long exhausted sighs, words slurring and dripping downward like melting wax, as if falling asleep mid-word.

sweats.brief: A breathless, clammy, panicking voice, panting and gulping between words, talking too fast then stalling, wet nervous swallows, always on the edge of hyperventilating.

snoot.brief: A deeply nasal, honking, congested voice, every word blown out through a long dripping nose, snorting and sniffing, slow and pretentious.

screamer.brief: A shrill, hoarse, ear-splitting voice that cannot stop screaming, raw and shredded from yelling, words coming out as shrieks and ragged gasps. Jarring and abrasive.

shiv.brief: A thin, wheedling, nasal voice, oily and too smooth then suddenly whiny, hissing every S, sniffing constantly through a very long nose.

pimples.brief: A twitchy, greasy young man's voice that cracks between octaves mid-word, squeaky and wet, lips smacking, little pained hisses as if every word squeezes a pimple. Uncomfortable to listen to.

melter.brief: A thick, sludgy, dripping voice whose words slide and melt into each other, syrupy and wet, bubbling now and then, sad and disgusting.

conehead~asmr.brief: A deranged, high, nasal, wet voice belonging to a grinning cone-headed creature. Sing-song and far too cheerful, spit bubbling on every S, sudden manic giggles, voice cracking and wobbling, unsettling pauses in the wrong places. Abrasive and off-putting. Speaking softly and slowly, right up against a very sensitive microphone, like a close-up ASMR video: quiet and intimate but clearly voiced, never whispering. Every word comes with crisp little clicks of the tongue, soft sticky mouth sounds and audible breaths. The same character and the same strangeness, just extremely close.
